title: 6.4 More Places to Visit
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Use the destination question with six new venues and travel points.
grammar_function: Visitors start at their hotel. The family’s outing is the museum, with a post office and movie theater located nearby. Find the bus stop for that outing. A clearly announced later journey connects the hotel, taxi and airport; airplane is retrieved as the reason for this travel point.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Use the destination question with six new venues and travel points.
